failure_ledger: unchanged fall or coarse pose-tracking failure only; speed, progress and collision diagnostics deferred

semantic_rule.translation: At least 0.3 continuous seconds with a body-frame horizontal component above 0.15 m/s
semantic_rule.body_turn: At least 0.2 continuous seconds with absolute root angular-Z velocity above 0.5 rad/s
semantic_rule.limits: Measured root angular-Z rate is a turning proxy; this is conservative semantic sampling, not dynamic qualification

preservation: All admitted originals retain positive mass, original family labels, reference arrays, clocks and admission gates unchanged

source.features_identity_check: Each train payload path, size, mtime, frame count and model signature checked against existing measured-feature record
